title: Plumeform template library
description: On warm paper: a bold two-part heading (the second half quieter), a row of topic pills with the first in ink, then a three-column grid of white glass link cards (mint icon tile, title, meta line, arrow) that lift, gain a teal edge and nudge their arrow on hover.
notes: the original's cards were not visible in the capture (they reveal on scroll); this layout follows its class names and the site's card style
